name: io.github.solrudev.simpleinstaller.impl.PackageUninstallerImpl$UninstallLauncherActivity
description: The SimpleInstaller library by solrudev starts this Activity for an app's uninstall request. It opens Android's confirmation screen for the named package and returns the user's choice.
disableEffect: The app cannot complete SimpleInstaller's uninstall request or receive the system confirmation result.
